overrides-empty:cards/0/hold_action/brow:
Override Dock
Rows appear below the dock when an override is active or pinned. The override timer follows the same rule.
Dock tap: control centre — presets, values, pins and the override timer.
Row tap: quick-edit. Double-tap: clear. Hold: help.
No reset: shown on the right of the dock, with a dot per locked override, and the dock border turns amber. A locked override will NOT clear itself when its target is met.
Net target: a daily net goal (sell) or budget (buy), set in the control centre. When net today passes it the watchdog clears that side and the dock shows TARGET MET or BUDGET REACHED until the timer ends, a new target is set, or midnight. The No Reset chip hides while a target is shown; padlocks on rows still apply.
Override timer: when running it shows as its own row. Tap the clock — there or in the control centre — for the timer sheet: extend chips, run-until chips, or an exact finish time. Pin it to keep it visible while it is off.
Presets: a preset saved with an Until time re-resolves that time every time it is applied.
Preset names: up to ~9 characters keep the row as-is. Longer names shrink the cost value in steps, then move it beside the kWh figure.
⚡ Spike Rules will always override everything
overrides-empty:cards/1/hold_action/brow:
Sell Override
SOC — Fixed battery level to sell down to, overriding the normal time-based curve. Setting 100% means no selling at all.
Price — Minimum sell price — energy only sold if price is above this value.
If only SOC is set, the curve price thresholds still apply.
If only Price is set, the SOC curve thresholds still apply.
If both are set, both conditions must be met — curves are ignored.
Setting SOC to 100% means: no selling.
Once the SOC target is reached, as long as the override timer is not running, both values turn off automatically.
Timer: give it a duration in hours OR an exact finish time — whichever you fill, the other clears.
Tap: edit values or apply a preset. Double-tap: clear.
⚡ Spike Rules will always override everything
